title: Elixirs Woodcutter Datapack
description: Datapack that adds wood to be able to be used in the stonecutter
body:
![Datapack banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7735a0dd5dea9f55e50df3187124ebcdee9a3bdf.png)

![INTRODUCTION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cce92c6373a5dea1677e773621483419332a16e4.png)
## What does Elixirs Woodcutter Datapack do?
It gives the stonecutter recipes to cut wood, logs and more into different kinds of wooden blocks

![Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/908a0d772794802f32cd37d1d3b24db5c29d5468.png)
**Wood types that work in the stonecutter are:** Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Crimson, Warped, Bamboo and latest wood type pale oak

![Elixirs Woodcutter recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40f756b58c70a33935b31ce434f495c38014c70c.gif)

![uninstallation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d90c07d871f089ad4927125e91e50790a9df5de.png)
**Just remove the datapack from the folder and it will be removed nothing else needed**
